hazards.control: Resin and carrier fluid handling per the data sheets; eye and skin protection.

name: Chemical consolidation and resin-coated gravel
function: Resin injected into the formation to bind the sand grains, or resin-coated gravel that cures in place, leaving the wellbore free of screens.

tabs.overview: Epoxy, furan, and phenolic systems; limited today by cost and by placement over intervals longer than a few tens of feet; resin-coated gravel has shown good early results and poor longevity in public reports.
tabs.engineering: Placement uniformity is the design problem; permeability loss after cure.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
tabs.failure_modes: Uneven placement, loss of permeability, sand returning as the resin degrades.
